{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH AND status == 'completed'
target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
                   (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
                   (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Verify the premise: at least one such customer exists
assert len(target_group) > 0, 'No NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH with status == completed found — contradicts premise.'

# Compute total count (only completed orders)
total = len(target_group)

# Compute number of conversions (converted == 1)
converted_count = target_group['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / total

# Print all required numbers for evidence
print(f"total = {total}")
print(f"converted_count = {converted_count}")
print(f"fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}")"}
